# Steve P / SPDUK Full AI Context

Steve P is a Senior Software Engineer building AI products and frontend systems, based in Cambridge, UK. His interactive portfolio collects projects, writing, browser games and experiments in a custom desktop interface built with React and TypeScript.

## Positioning

The site is a place to explore Steve's work and try things he built. The About page introduces his current role and selected work. Projects includes this portfolio and an archive of earlier projects. Writing contains notes on software development and the tools he uses. Historical project and writing articles retain their original prose and publication dates.

## Current Role

At [Zuora](https://www.zuora.com/), Steve is a Senior Software Engineer & Forward Deployed Engineer focused on AI. He builds product experiences and works with customers to turn practical problems into working software.

## Interactive Work

The portfolio's desktop uses a recursive layout model and a reducer for opening, docking, grouping and closing windows. A versioned session snapshot restores the workspace. Preferences use local storage. Article tabs, filters and reading positions use their own session snapshot. Storage is optional.

Gatsby renders each original article as HTML at its own URL before JavaScript runs. The desktop's project and writing apps add tabs and load the same content through validated JSON payloads.

Asteroids, Snake and Breakout separate simulation from Canvas rendering. Games pause when the app becomes inactive, the browser loses focus or the page becomes hidden.

Signal Lab draws patterns in Canvas 2D from a preset, seed, elapsed time and pointer position. Visitors can change the pattern and save a PNG. Animation pauses when the app loses attention.
